# Review pull requests

Before reviewing:

1. Read `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read `.agents/review.md`.
3. Read `.agents/architecture.md` when the change touches substantive code paths.
4. Review the complete pull request diff and the relevant implementation and tests.
5. Report findings according to `.agents/review.md`.

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the source of truth if another instruction conflicts with it.
